Lady chapel in the Dernekamp hamlet, Kirchspiel, Dülmen , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The St Mary’s Chapel chapel is closely linked to the historic Visbeck manor. The estate itself was first mentioned in documents in 1186 as Villa Visbeck and developed into a fortified building on two islands in the Middle Ages. From 1338, it belonged to the Lords of Visbeck until the family died out in 1540 and the property changed hands several times.
